text: You say "buying here buys the climax risk." Fair; it is why I hold 2 on a 10-session horizon. But a leader at its highs is what I buy (C12), and the biggest chunk of a move comes just before it ends (C15); calling the climax early is opinion, not price (C2). My answer to climax risk is the danger signal: one fade of 1x atr 2.45 off the day's high (my translation) ends it on sight (C7). I drop support if the next high fails to follow through (C17), or sma_dist 53.73% stretches further with mp turning DECELERATING.
